metadata.label: Distant Galaxy
metadata.description: Adds one faint, slowly rotating two-arm spiral galaxy far in the background; bass brightens its core slightly.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image to add the galaxy behind.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image with a faint distant galaxy added.

controlDescriptions.brightness: Overall galaxy strength. It stays very dim at every setting.
controlDescriptions.positionX: Horizontal position of the galaxy centre across the frame.
controlDescriptions.positionY: Vertical position of the galaxy centre across the frame.
controlDescriptions.rotationSpeed: How fast the spiral turns. Zero holds it still.
controlDescriptions.size: Radius of the galaxy as a fraction of the frame height.

metadata.label: Shooting Stars
metadata.description: Adds shooting stars that cross the frame on bass and onset beats.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image to add shooting stars on top of.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image with beat-driven shooting stars added.

controlDescriptions.beatSensitivity: How easily a bass or broadband onset counts as a beat. Higher values trigger on weaker hits.
controlDescriptions.brightnessMax: Brightest glow a new star can pick.
controlDescriptions.brightnessMin: Dimmest glow a new star can pick.
controlDescriptions.idleSpawn: Random stars per minute with no beat. Zero turns idle stars off.
controlDescriptions.lengthMax: Longest tail a new star can pick.
controlDescriptions.lengthMin: Shortest tail a new star can pick.
controlDescriptions.minGap: Shortest time in seconds between two beat-spawned stars.
controlDescriptions.sizeMax: Thickest head and tail a new star can pick.
controlDescriptions.sizeMin: Thinnest head and tail a new star can pick.
controlDescriptions.speed: How fast each star crosses the frame.

metadata.label: Spectrum Kelp
metadata.description: Adds a dim background of swaying kelp fronds in uneven clumps. Each frond follows one spectrum band.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image to add the kelp behind.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image with faint kelp added in dark areas.

controlDescriptions.bandMapping: 0 maps low to high frequencies from left to right. 1 assigns bands in a hashed order.
controlDescriptions.brightness: Overall kelp glow. It stays dim and only shows in dark areas.
controlDescriptions.clumping: 0 spaces fronds evenly. 1 groups them in uneven clumps with gaps and a few strays.
controlDescriptions.count: Number of kelp fronds. Each frond is one spectrum band.
controlDescriptions.height: Maximum frond height as a fraction of the frame height.
controlDescriptions.hue: Tint of the emissive tips and nodes. Bands spread the hue across the row.
controlDescriptions.response: How strongly band loudness raises and kicks the fronds.
controlDescriptions.sway: Strength of the slow current and traveling waves along each frond.

controls.description: How fast shockwaves expand, in screen units per second.

controls.label: Cooldown
controls.description: Minimum seconds between shockwave triggers.

controls.label: Trigger sensitivity
controls.description: How easily bass, broadband-flux and snare onsets fire shockwaves; higher lowers the onset thresholds.

controls.label: Idle interval
controls.description: Fire a shockwave anyway if nothing fired for this many seconds; 0 disables.

controls.label: Brightness
controls.description: Multiplies jelly color before the soft tone curve.

controls.label: Tone softness
controls.description: Coefficient k in col/(1+col*k); higher compresses highlights more.

controls.label: Swim frequency
controls.description: Average pulse bursts per second for each jellyfish; bursts come at random intervals.

controls.label: Thrust
controls.description: How far each bell stroke pushes a jellyfish along its heading.

controls.label: Stroke depth
controls.description: How far the bell margin closes inward and down during each contraction (the dome stays rounded); 0 disables the squeeze.

controls.label: Lunge
controls.description: Forward distance a jellyfish lunges along its heading during each contraction (power stroke); it then coasts.

controls.label: Distortion
controls.description: Directly scales how strongly shockwaves bend the image (refraction amplitude); 20 is a strong warp.

controls.label: Ring count
controls.description: Concentric rings per shockwave: one bright leading ring plus fainter trailing ones.

controls.label: Ring spacing
controls.description: Gap between successive rings, in screen units, scaled by the jelly size.

controls.label: Spread
controls.description: Horizontal spread of the swarm; 1 spans the full screen width, 0 stacks them at the centre, 2 spreads past both edges.

controls.label: Reach
controls.description: How far a shockwave travels, in aspect-corrected screen units, before it fades out and is recycled.

controls.label: Flow
controls.description: How much tentacles drift, fan out and sway in the water current; 0 keeps them trailing straight.

controls.label: Heading spread
controls.description: How widely jellyfish headings spread away from up; 1 gives about plus or minus 100 degrees, with a few drifting down-diagonal.

controls.label: Speed variation
controls.description: Per-jelly differences in speed, lunge and stroke tempo; 1 gives about 0.4x to 1.8x.

controls.label: Depth speed
controls.description: Parallax: scales drift, lunge and glide speed by each jelly size relative to Size max, so closer jellies move faster; 0 disables.

controls.label: Inner glow
controls.description: Inner light of each translucent bell: apex glow, glowing margin, subsurface tint and luminous ribs.

controls.label: Depth haze
controls.description: Smaller (farther) jellies get softer, blurred and tinted toward violet-blue haze; close ones gain a soft halo. 0 disables.

controls.label: Hero size
controls.description: Jelly 0 becomes a slow hero this many times Size max, drifting in the left or right third and staying on screen; 0 disables.

controls.label: Light trails
controls.description: Brightness of the dissolving glowing specks left behind each lunge (last 3 lunges, fade in about 1.5 s); 0 disables.

controls.label: Tentacle spectrum
controls.description: Maps the spectrum across each jelly's tentacles (low on one side, high on the other); each band brightens its tentacle line and dots.

controls.label: Rim spectrum
controls.description: Circular equaliser: the bell rim glows and swells outward with the spectrum band at each rim angle.

controls.label: Hero lead
controls.description: Hero jelly inner glow follows the overall level; its hue slides from warm (low spectral centroid) to cool (high).

controls.label: Beat dots
controls.description: Amount of the eased downward dot-flow step added on each detected beat, on top of the continuous flow.

controls.label: Beat step
controls.description: Beat step size in dot spacings (scaled by Beat dots and Reactivity); eases in over about 0.15 s.

controls.label: Hero roam
controls.description: How freely the hero roams: it swims toward a new random point every 8-15 s within about 80% of the screen and stays on screen; 0 keeps it in its home box.

controls.label: Current spread
controls.description: Slow per-jelly water current: tentacle tips fan wider and drift together in a slowly changing direction; 0 disables.

controls.label: Tentacle push
controls.description: A passing shockwave pushes and splays tentacles away from its origin, then they spring back over about 1.5 s; 0 disables.

publicControls.label: Film grain

controlSchema.label: Bass pulse

controlSchema.label: Halo
controlSchema.description: Soft glow around the bell.

controlSchema.label: Hue
controlSchema.description: Base bell color.

controlSchema.label: Hue variety
controlSchema.description: How far each jellyfish hue spreads around the color wheel; 0 uses the base hue for all.

controlSchema.label: Count
controlSchema.description: Number of tentacles.

controlSchema.label: Length
controlSchema.description: Longest tentacle length relative to bell size.

controlSchema.label: Length variation
controlSchema.description: How much shorter some tentacles are.

controlSchema.label: Glow
controlSchema.description: Tentacle brightness.

controlSchema.label: Speed
controlSchema.description: How fast glowing dots flow down the tentacles.

controlSchema.label: Speed variation
controlSchema.description: How much dot speed differs between tentacles.

controlSchema.label: Density
controlSchema.description: How many dots appear along each tentacle.

controlSchema.label: Count
controlSchema.description: Number of frilly oral arms near the centre.

controlSchema.label: Length
controlSchema.description: Oral arm length relative to the tentacles.

controlSchema.label: Glow
controlSchema.description: Oral arm brightness.

controlSchema.label: Mids sway
controlSchema.description: How strongly mids make the tentacles sway.

controlSchema.label: Reactivity
controlSchema.description: Master scale for all audio reactions.

controlSchema.label: Count
controlSchema.description: Number of jellyfish floating on screen.

controlSchema.label: Size min
controlSchema.description: Smallest jellyfish scale, as a multiplier of Size. Each jelly picks a stable random scale between min and max (swapped if min > max).

controlSchema.label: Size max
controlSchema.description: Largest jellyfish scale, as a multiplier of Size. The largest scale is the nearest depth: full brightness and full speed.

controlSchema.label: Tilt
controlSchema.description: Extra slow wandering of each heading, in radians.

controlSchema.label: Drift speed
controlSchema.description: How fast jellyfish drift upward.

controlSchema.label: Wave speed
controlSchema.description: How fast shockwaves expand, in screen units per second.

controlSchema.label: Cooldown
controlSchema.description: Minimum seconds between shockwave triggers.

controlSchema.label: Trigger sensitivity
controlSchema.description: How easily bass, broadband-flux and snare onsets fire shockwaves; higher lowers the onset thresholds.

controlSchema.label: Idle interval
controlSchema.description: Fire a shockwave anyway if nothing fired for this many seconds; 0 disables.

controlSchema.label: Brightness
controlSchema.description: Multiplies jelly color before the soft tone curve.

controlSchema.label: Tone softness
controlSchema.description: Coefficient k in col/(1+col*k); higher compresses highlights more.

controlSchema.label: Swim frequency
controlSchema.description: Average pulse bursts per second for each jellyfish; bursts come at random intervals.

controlSchema.label: Thrust
controlSchema.description: How far each bell stroke pushes a jellyfish along its heading.

controlSchema.label: Stroke depth
controlSchema.description: How far the bell margin closes inward and down during each contraction (the dome stays rounded); 0 disables the squeeze.

controlSchema.label: Lunge
controlSchema.description: Forward distance a jellyfish lunges along its heading during each contraction (power stroke); it then coasts.

controlSchema.label: Distortion
controlSchema.description: Directly scales how strongly shockwaves bend the image (refraction amplitude); 20 is a strong warp.

controlSchema.label: Ring count
controlSchema.description: Concentric rings per shockwave: one bright leading ring plus fainter trailing ones.

controlSchema.label: Ring spacing
controlSchema.description: Gap between successive rings, in screen units, scaled by the jelly size.

controlSchema.label: Spread
controlSchema.description: Horizontal spread of the swarm; 1 spans the full screen width, 0 stacks them at the centre, 2 spreads past both edges.

controlSchema.label: Reach
controlSchema.description: How far a shockwave travels, in aspect-corrected screen units, before it fades out and is recycled.

controlSchema.label: Flow
controlSchema.description: How much tentacles drift, fan out and sway in the water current; 0 keeps them trailing straight.

controlSchema.label: Heading spread
controlSchema.description: How widely jellyfish headings spread away from up; 1 gives about plus or minus 100 degrees, with a few drifting down-diagonal.

controlSchema.label: Speed variation
controlSchema.description: Per-jelly differences in speed, lunge and stroke tempo; 1 gives about 0.4x to 1.8x.

controlSchema.label: Depth speed
controlSchema.description: Parallax: scales drift, lunge and glide speed by each jelly size relative to Size max, so closer jellies move faster; 0 disables.

controlSchema.label: Inner glow
controlSchema.description: Inner light of each translucent bell: apex glow, glowing margin, subsurface tint and luminous ribs.

controlSchema.label: Depth haze
controlSchema.description: Smaller (farther) jellies get softer, blurred and tinted toward violet-blue haze; close ones gain a soft halo. 0 disables.

controlSchema.label: Hero size
controlSchema.description: Jelly 0 becomes a slow hero this many times Size max, drifting in the left or right third and staying on screen; 0 disables.

controlSchema.label: Light trails
controlSchema.description: Brightness of the dissolving glowing specks left behind each lunge (last 3 lunges, fade in about 1.5 s); 0 disables.

controlSchema.label: Tentacle spectrum
controlSchema.description: Maps the spectrum across each jelly's tentacles (low on one side, high on the other); each band brightens its tentacle line and dots.

controlSchema.label: Rim spectrum
controlSchema.description: Circular equaliser: the bell rim glows and swells outward with the spectrum band at each rim angle.

controlSchema.label: Hero lead
controlSchema.description: Hero jelly inner glow follows the overall level; its hue slides from warm (low spectral centroid) to cool (high).

controlSchema.label: Beat dots
controlSchema.description: Amount of the eased downward dot-flow step added on each detected beat, on top of the continuous flow.

controlSchema.label: Beat step
controlSchema.description: Beat step size in dot spacings (scaled by Beat dots and Reactivity); eases in over about 0.15 s.

controlSchema.label: Hero roam
controlSchema.description: How freely the hero roams: it swims toward a new random point every 8-15 s within about 80% of the screen and stays on screen; 0 keeps it in its home box.

controlSchema.label: Current spread
controlSchema.description: Slow per-jelly water current: tentacle tips fan wider and drift together in a slowly changing direction; 0 disables.

controlSchema.label: Tentacle push
controlSchema.description: A passing shockwave pushes and splays tentacles away from its origin, then they spring back over about 1.5 s; 0 disables.

controlSchema.label: Brightness
controlSchema.description: Overall galaxy strength. It stays very dim at every setting.

controlSchema.label: Rotation speed
controlSchema.description: How fast the spiral turns. Zero holds it still.

controlSchema.label: Position X
controlSchema.description: Horizontal position of the galaxy centre across the frame.

controlSchema.label: Position Y
controlSchema.description: Vertical position of the galaxy centre across the frame.

controlSchema.label: Size
controlSchema.description: Radius of the galaxy as a fraction of the frame height.

controlSchema.label: Size
controlSchema.description: Whale length relative to screen height. Small values read as farther away.

controlSchema.label: Depth haze
controlSchema.description: Amount of depth fog and softness. Higher values push the whale farther back.

controlSchema.label: Cross time (s)
controlSchema.description: Seconds the whale takes to cross the frame. A pause follows each crossing.

controlSchema.label: Height
controlSchema.description: Vertical lane of the swim path. Zero is the screen center.

controlSchema.label: Direction
controlSchema.description: 0 swims left to right, 1 swims right to left, 2 alternates each crossing.

controlSchema.label: Brightness
controlSchema.description: Strength of the silhouette, rim light and glowing spots. It stays dim.

controlSchema.label: Hue
controlSchema.description: Tint of the bioluminescent rim and spots.

controlSchema.label: Song
controlSchema.description: How strongly bass makes the whale emit a faint ring from its head.

controlSchema.label: Frond count
controlSchema.description: Number of kelp fronds. Each frond is one spectrum band.

controlSchema.label: Clumping
controlSchema.description: 0 spaces fronds evenly. 1 groups them in uneven clumps with gaps and a few strays.

controlSchema.label: Seed
controlSchema.description: Changes the random clump layout.

controlSchema.label: Height
controlSchema.description: Maximum frond height as a fraction of the frame height.

controlSchema.label: Sway
controlSchema.description: Strength of the slow current and traveling waves along each frond.

controlSchema.label: Brightness
controlSchema.description: Overall kelp glow. It stays dim and only shows in dark areas.

controlSchema.label: Tip hue
controlSchema.description: Tint of the emissive tips and nodes. Bands spread the hue across the row.

controlSchema.label: Band mapping
controlSchema.description: 0 maps low to high frequencies from left to right. 1 assigns bands in a hashed order.

controlSchema.label: Response
controlSchema.description: How strongly band loudness raises and kicks the fronds.

controlSchema.label: Brightness
controlSchema.description: Strength of the veil. It stays very faint at every setting.

controlSchema.label: Period
controlSchema.description: Seconds between one band and the next crossing the frame.

controlSchema.label: Width
controlSchema.description: Band width as a fraction of the screen.

controlSchema.label: Angle
controlSchema.description: Drift direction in radians. 0 drifts left to right.

controlSchema.label: Hue shift
controlSchema.description: Slides the teal, violet and gold colors along the length of the band.

controlSchema.label: Brightness
controlSchema.description: Overall nebula strength. It stays dim at every setting.

controlSchema.label: Drift speed
controlSchema.description: How fast the gas clouds drift.

controlSchema.label: Scale
controlSchema.description: Size of the cloud features. Higher values give smaller clouds.

controlSchema.label: Hue shift
controlSchema.description: Tint blended into the magenta and teal gas.

controlSchema.label: Bass glow
controlSchema.description: How strongly bass brightens the nebula.

controlSchema.label: Density
controlSchema.description: How many grid cells hold a plankton mote.

controlSchema.label: Size
controlSchema.description: Size of each glowing mote.

controlSchema.label: Drift speed
controlSchema.description: How fast the motes rise and drift.

controlSchema.label: Highs sparkle
controlSchema.description: How strongly highs make motes flash brighter.

controlSchema.label: Brightness
controlSchema.description: Overall mote glow strength.

controlSchema.label: Scatter
controlSchema.description: How far hi-hat surges push nearby motes outward before they resettle.

controlSchema.label: Scatter radius
controlSchema.description: Size of the area around each surge epicenter that is affected.

controlSchema.label: Scatter glow
controlSchema.description: How much motes brighten while a surge passes through them.

controlSchema.label: Count
controlSchema.description: Number of fish swimming in the scene (up to 40).

controlSchema.label: Size
controlSchema.description: Global size multiplier: base fish length in screen units (screen height is 2).

controlSchema.label: Size min
controlSchema.description: Smallest fish size as a multiple of Size. Swapped with Size max if larger.

controlSchema.label: Size max
controlSchema.description: Largest fish size as a multiple of Size. Swapped with Size min if smaller.

controlSchema.label: Size variety
controlSchema.description: How evenly fish sizes spread between min and max. 0 clusters them at the middle size, 1 spreads them fully.

controlSchema.label: Speed
controlSchema.description: Master multiplier for cruise and dart speed.

controlSchema.label: Dart speed
controlSchema.description: Extra multiplier for the burst speed when a fish darts away.

controlSchema.label: Hide time
controlSchema.description: Average seconds a fish lingers hidden in the tentacles before darting out. 0 means no hiding.

controlSchema.label: Boldness
controlSchema.description: Extra multiplier on hide time per fish personality. Higher means longer hiding.

controlSchema.label: Wanderiness
controlSchema.description: How randomly free-swimming fish change direction. 0 swims straight, higher meanders.

controlSchema.label: Curiosity
controlSchema.description: Chance that a fish heads for a jelly to hide instead of keeping on wandering. 0 never hides.

controlSchema.label: Schooling
controlSchema.description: How strongly wandering fish follow and align with their nearest neighbor. 0 swims independently.

controlSchema.label: Startle
controlSchema.description: How easily bass onsets and nearby shockwaves startle hiding fish into darting. 0 disables.

controlSchema.label: Edge avoid
controlSchema.description: How early fish turn away from the screen edges. 0 lets them swim right to the edge.

controlSchema.label: Hue shift
controlSchema.description: Shifts the warm gold and coral fish colors around the color wheel.

controlSchema.label: Hue variety
controlSchema.description: How much each fish differs in color from the others. 0 makes every fish the same.

controlSchema.label: Band width
controlSchema.description: Width of the white stripes. 0 removes them.

controlSchema.label: Outline
controlSchema.description: Thickness of the dark outline around the body, fins and stripes. 0 removes it.

controlSchema.label: Fin size
controlSchema.description: Scale of the tail, dorsal, ventral and pectoral fins.

controlSchema.label: Tail wiggle
controlSchema.description: Amount of tail sway and body ripple while swimming. 0 holds the tail rigid.

controlSchema.label: Glow
controlSchema.description: Strength of the soft glow halo around each fish.

controlSchema.label: Wake
controlSchema.description: Brightness of the trail left behind swimming and darting fish. 0 disables it.

controlSchema.label: Wake length
controlSchema.description: How long the wake trail lingers behind a fish. Longer means a longer trail.
